NEW MEXICO (KRQE) – Bigfoot is an enigma; this creature has been "seen" many times with assorted recollections of size and appearance, but still no definitive proof of this ape has been captured.

This week on New Mexico Strange, KRQE's Chad Brummett is joined by author Ben Radford to discuss the creature and show Chad the holes in a lot of the different sightings of it. Ben Radford shows off what he learned while writing his new book Weird New Mexico, a continuation of his previous book Mysterious New Mexico that was released in 2014.

You can learn more about Ben Radford and his new book Weird New Mexico by clicking here.

About New Mexico StrangeNew Mexico is perceived worldwide as a mecca for the extraordinary. Whether it's the healing soil of Chimayo, the haunted trails of the Old West, or visitors from the final frontier, our state is home to countless myths and mysteries. New Mexico Strange is KRQE News 13’s online exclusive web series, celebrating our unique history and shedding light on the shadows of the unexplained, unexplored, and unknown. Hosted by Chad Brummett and Stephanie Chavez, New Mexico Strange takes viewers through some of the Land of Enchantment's most mysterious folklore and conspiracies.
